description_en: Modifies a data synchronization task by calling the ModifyDtsJob operation
description_zh: 调用ModifyDtsJob接口修改同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun dts modify-dts-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id dtsbi6e22ay2430000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDtsJob

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the data synchronization instance
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
This parameter is required only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
指定同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，才需要传入本参数
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The modified synchronization objects, in JSON format. For more information about the definition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html.
The original DbList is overwritten by the new DbList. Make sure that the new DbList contains all the objects that need to be synchronized. Otherwise, synchronization objects may be lost. Modify this parameter with caution.
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html to query the current synchronization objects before you modify them based on your business requirements. For example, if the current objects are tables A and B, and you want to add table C, specify tables A, B, and C in this parameter.
The maximum size of DbList is 1 MB.
If DbList contains filter conditions, the total length of DbList (including filter conditions) cannot exceed 1 MB.
For distributed tasks (such as migration or synchronization tasks whose source is PolarDB-X 1.0), DbList is split based on physical shards and multiple subtasks are generated. The maximum size of DbList for each subtask is 1 MB
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的同步对象，格式为JSON串。详细定义，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html。
原DbList会被新传入的DbList覆盖，请确保新传入的DbList数据中包含所有需要同步的对象，否则可能会导致同步对象丢失，请谨慎修改。
建议您提前调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html查询当前同步对象，然后根据业务需要输入修改后的同步对象。例如，当前对象为表A、B，现需要新增对象表C，那么您需要在本参数同时传入表A、B、C。
DbList最多支持传入1 MB的数据。
若DbList中包含过滤条件，则DbList整体（含过滤条件）的长度最大支持1 MB。
分布式任务（例如源端为PolarDB-X 1.0的迁移或同任务）的DbList会根据物理分表进行拆分并生成多个子任务，子任务的DbList最多支持1 MB的数据
parameters.name: db_list

parameters.help_en: A field dedicated to T+1 business scenarios. This is an ETL operator and a business-specific field
parameters.help_zh: T+1业务专用的字段，ETL算子，为业务专用字段
parameters.name: etl_operator_column_reference

parameters.help_en: The method used to modify the synchronization task. If this parameter is not specified, the synchronization objects are modified by default. Set this parameter to UPDATE_RESERVED to modify reserved parameters
parameters.help_zh: 指示修改同步任务的方式，不填默认修改同步对象；填写UPDATE_RESERVED为修改预留参数
parameters.name: modify_type_enum

parameters.help_en: The reserved parameters of DTS. The update method is append rather than overwrite. The value is in the MAP JSON format. You can specify this parameter to meet special requirements, such as whether to automatically start a precheck. The usage is similar to that of the Reserve parameter. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273111.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS预留参数，更新方式为新增而非覆盖，格式为MAP JSON串，您可以传入本参数实现特殊需求（例如是否自动启动预检查）。使用方法与Reserve参数类似，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273111.html
parameters.name: reserved

parameters.help_en: The OSS URL of the synchronization file
parameters.name: file_oss_url

parameters.help_en: The name of the table to be filtered
parameters.name: filter_table_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform schema migration or initial schema synchronization. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行库表结构迁移或初始化，取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: structure_initialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform full data migration or initial full data synchronization. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行全量数据迁移或全量数据初始化，取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: data_initialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform incremental data migration or synchronization. Valid values:

false: no.
true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行增量数据迁移或同步，取值：

false：否。
true：是
parameters.name: data_synchronization

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether this is a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zero_etl_job

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en:
The error message returned if the call failed.
The data type of this parameter should be String. An example value is The request processing has failed due to some unknown error
ErrMessage.description_zh:
调用出错时返回的错误信息。
该参数的数据类型应为String，实际示例值为The request processing has failed due to some unknown error

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
